evidence.observation: svc-backup fails from 10.0.2.15 (BACKUP01) at 08:00:09Z with the bad-password substatus.
The same failure repeats every 30 seconds from the same host and account with no variation: a retry loop, not guessing.
The loop is still running hours later (08:00-12:00Z) and only ever targets this one service account from its expected source.

rationale: A single service account retries a stale password at a fixed interval from the one host that is allowed to use it (BACKUP01 per the asset inventory). Periodic, single-source, single-account behaviour is a misconfiguration. Suppress only this exact pair, temporarily, and fix the credential.
root_cause_fix: Rotate the svc-backup password stored in the backup job and confirm the next run authenticates.

tuning.reason: Backup job retries a stale password every 30 s; credential rotation tracked in INC-5521. Temporary.

next_steps: Remove the exception when INC-5521 closes
Alert if svc-backup ever fails from another address
